Title: Azure Maps Web SDK Map Control version 2.0.x and Azure Maps Service Module will be retired on 30 September 2026

Body.Content:
Azure Maps Web SDK Map Control version 2.0.x and Azure Maps Service Module will be retired on 30 September 2026. Please transition to Azure Maps Web SDK Map Control version 3 if you’re on Azure Maps Web SDK control version 2.0.x and Azure Maps JavaScript REST SDK if you are currently using Azure Maps Service Module by 30 September 2026.  
 

The Azure Maps team is retiring Web SDK Map Control version 2.0.x and Azure Maps Service Module. In Lieu, Azure Maps has deployed Web SDK Map Control version 3 for Azure Maps Web SDK and the Azure Maps JavaScript REST SDK in lieu of the Azure Maps Service Module. The Web SDK Map Control version 3 offers various enhancements while the Azure Maps JavaScript REST SDK provides improved stability. Learn more about Web SDK Map Control version 3 here. Learn more information on how to use the Azure Maps JavaScript REST SDK here.

You can continue to use Web SDK Map Control version 2.0.x and the Azure Maps Service module until 30 September 2026 without disruption. On 30 September 2026 workloads running Web SDK Map Control version 2.0.x and the Azure Maps Service Module will be deleted and any associated application data will be lost. Resources to aid in your migration can be found below.

 

Required action

To avoid service disruptions, please follow our instructions to migrate to the Azure Maps Web SDK version 3.0 and developer guide to migrate to Azure Maps JavaScript REST SDK by 30 September 2026.  

Help and Support

If you have questions, get answers from community experts Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
